agent_explanation: Thin wall (h=0.28) with high-speed body vx=45 m/s. With dt=0.003 and 5 substeps, per-substep displacement ~0.027m, body arrives at left face at step 16-17 then penetrates deeply by step 18. Collision impulse/positional correction insufficient to prevent overlap beyond 0.15 tolerance. Reducing speed prevents tunneling/penetration, indicating CCD/discrete collision handling fails at high velocity vs thin geometry.
